skill.summary: Work with invoices, contacts, accounting records, and finance workflows in Xero — powered by ClawLink.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the xero-accounting skill, enabling integration with Xero via ClawLink.
- Supports working with invoices, contacts, accounting records, and finance workflows directly from chat.
- Guided setup includes installing and pairing the ClawLink plugin, and connecting Xero through an OAuth flow.
- Provides dynamic tool discovery with ClawLink; capabilities depend on current user connections and permissions.
- Emphasizes user confirmation for sensitive or external-facing actions and never requires raw Xero credentials in chat.
